metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace by kuboon.

plugins.name: github-actions-versions
plugins.description: Pin GitHub Actions to current, non-deprecated major versions when writing or editing workflows.

plugins.name: deno-remix-init
plugins.description: When initializing a new project, use Deno (not Node.js) and Remix v3 as the web framework, following the deno-remix-reference patterns.

plugins.name: remix-ui-text-field-editable
plugins.description: When writing a freely-typed text input in @remix-run/ui (Remix v3), use defaultValue= instead of value= or it will race the framework's controlled-value reflection and become uneditable.

plugins.name: browser-how-to
plugins.description: When integrating Add to Home Screen (a2hs), passkeys, or web push into a web frontend, use the @kuboon/browser-how-to library to detect support, escape in-app browsers, and guide users.

plugins.name: github-page-preview
plugins.description: When deploying a static site to GitHub Pages with per-PR preview deployments, call kuboon's reusable workflow github-page-with-preview.yaml instead of hand-writing pages jobs.

plugins.name: uint8array-base64
plugins.description: For base64 (and hex) in JavaScript, use the native Uint8Array.fromBase64()/toBase64()/setFromBase64() methods instead of btoa/atob or Buffer. Works in Deno and the browser.

plugins.name: admin-view-toggle
plugins.description: When building admin-only features, give admin users a frontend-only 一般/admin view switch that defaults to 一般, so one account can eyeball both UIs. The backend keeps authorizing as admin and never reads the toggle.

plugins.name: deno-min-dep-age
plugins.description: When a Deno dependency update is blocked by minimumDependencyAge, exclude the self-published @kuboon scope via minimumDependencyAge.exclude (Deno 2.9+) instead of lowering the age or passing --min-dep-age 0.

plugins.name: remix-v3-upgrade
plugins.description: Upgrade a Remix v3 project across beta and rc boundaries, currently up to 3.0.0-rc.1: the @remix-run/* version table for each hop plus every breaking change, including the ones the compiler will not catch — such as ui@0.8.0 renaming every rmx-* DOM attribute to data-rmx-*.

plugins.name: remix-db-migrations-deno
plugins.description: Run @remix-run/data-table migrations from Deno: remix.json db config, timestamped up.sql/down.sql directories, deno task wiring, the Deno-specific traps, and — for Turso/libSQL, which remix db cannot drive — the CLI shipped by @kuboon/remix-data-table-sqlite-turso.

plugins.name: game-feel
plugins.description: Add game feel / juice — screen shake, hit-stop, easing, squash & stretch, knockback, layered feedback — as engine-neutral techniques. Vendored verbatim from gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills under Apache-2.0.
